title: Nirmaan Integrated Platform
description: A production enterprise platform that streamlines project request management, approval workflows, role-based access control, notifications, and organizational administration through a unified web application.
highlights: Developed production features using Next.js, React, TypeScript, and tRPC.
Built project request workflows, dashboards, and administrative modules.
Developed backend APIs and integrated PostgreSQL using Drizzle ORM.
Implemented authentication, role-based access control, and user management.
Built responsive interfaces using Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui.
Optimized application performance using TanStack React Query.
Collaborated on testing, debugging, code reviews, and production deployments.

title: HYSEA CSR & Impact Hiring
description: A production module within the Nirmaan Integrated Platform that enables NGOs, corporate partners, and job seekers to collaborate through CSR initiatives and impact hiring programs.
highlights: Developed responsive interfaces using Next.js, React, and TypeScript.
Built business workflows for CSR project collaboration and impact hiring.
Integrated backend APIs for dynamic data management.
Worked with PostgreSQL and Drizzle ORM for structured data operations.
Built reusable UI components following modern frontend practices.

title: Real-Time Chat Application
description: A full-stack real-time messaging application featuring authentication, live communication, and responsive user experience.
highlights: Built responsive UI using React and TypeScript.
Integrated authentication and secure message validation.
Designed reusable chat components and efficient state management.
